# File structure

Read before creating any file or folder. A new top-level folder needs a line here first.

```
<!-- full target tree. One comment per entry: what lives there and which side owns it. -->
AGENTS.md            agent instructions (source)
CLAUDE.md            pointer to AGENTS.md
docs/                indexes + area files; archive/ holds history; reference/ holds the idea
.agents/skills/      installed skills (lock file at root)
```
